description: Authenticators such as passwords, tokens, and certificates are not properly managed throughout their lifecycle. This signal indicates that authenticators may not be issued, rotated, or revoked according to security requirements.
applicability: Applicable to all authentication mechanisms. Includes password management, certificate lifecycle, token issuance, and authenticator recovery processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through authenticator management process review, password policy assessment, and certificate lifecycle verification.
